scientific_limitations: The inclusion is shown strict, but no complete eigenvalue characterization of the infinite-block algebra is claimed.
Applies to bounded block-quasi-radial symbols and diagonal trace-class covariance compatible with finite blocks, not the whole noncommutative Toeplitz algebra.
Historical priority may be affected by inaccessible 1995 full text or unindexed results.
title: Tail-insertion rigidity and the absence of compact operators in infinite-variable quasi-radial Toeplitz algebras
